disposition_reason: ED-15 forbids PASS without signed thresholds. Tool registers, margin units and supported parameters are vendor/controller-specific; choosing AMD or Intel would invent core command semantics and an incompatible oracle.

Intel and AMD memory-margin tools/manuals are not interchangeable authorities.

test_case.purpose: After vendor alignment, measure mapped controller/channel/DIMM margins with the supported tool and compare raw results only to the matching approved manual thresholds.
required_package: Authoritative Intel or AMD platform identity
Matching tool/version/license/support matrix and manual revision
test_case.test_command: DO NOT RUN. First align one platform-specific tool, validation manual revision, topology and numeric oracle; then execute only the approved margin procedure.
test_case.expected_result: Cannot be stated until the matching manual supplies margin units, limits and tolerance for the approved platform/tool.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS from AMD output judged by Intel guidance, generic 'margin result', or invented thresholds.
safety_gate: Never mix vendor tool/manual or guess voltage/margin controls
Preserve evidence; restore settings; no auto-retry
test_case.recovery: Cannot be finalized until the supported tool's changed-state semantics and vendor recovery are known; the approved contract must restore training/voltage/settings.
